name: opencomet-ai-sih
description: OpenCometAI-SIH — on-device visual perception for light-weight browser agents (SIH PS 26171). Marker package: 'type: module' makes Node parse the project's ESM .js sources without the MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON reparse warning (imports are ESM everywhere; the vendored wasm glue files are browser-only and never imported by Node). No dependencies — the extension is dependency-free by design.
